title: Setup Documentation

setupSurfaces.setupRole: Read roadmap, session context, standards and execution evidence before selecting a task.
Validate foundation product artifacts only when the roadmap-selected task impacts ai-foundation.
Validate knowledge, registry and evaluation artifacts only when the roadmap-selected task impacts ai-knowledge.
Validate template, scaffold and testing artifacts only when the roadmap-selected task impacts ai-template.

prerequisites.name: Git
prerequisites.purpose: Inspect repository status and commit history in the root and product repositories.

prerequisites.name: Node.js and npm
prerequisites.purpose: Run product validators and package scripts where those scripts exist.

prerequisites.name: PowerShell
prerequisites.purpose: Run documented Windows setup and validation commands.

prerequisites.name: Engram CLI
prerequisites.purpose: Load and save auxiliary continuity checkpoints for project ai-native.

bootstrapSteps.action: Verify each product repository status independently.
Read roadmap, session context and relevant execution archive.
Confirm the next eligible task and impacted repository from the roadmap.
Run only validators that exist and apply to the impacted repository.
Commit product changes only in the impacted product repository when product changes are required.
Commit governance changes in the root repository.
Attempt push once per affected repository and record policy or remote verification blocks as CONTEXTUAL_NON_BLOCKING.

installationDocumentation.guidance: Open the governance repository and inspect roadmap/session context before task work.
Open each product repository independently and run relevant validators only when impacted.
Use project ai-native for auxiliary continuity checkpoints and prefer git/governance if Engram is unavailable.

setupGuardrails: Setup documentation preserves independent Git boundaries between root governance and product repositories.
Roadmap, session context and execution archive are the mandatory setup reading order.
Documentation-only tasks do not install packages, create services or change runtime state.
Documentation-only tasks do not modify VERSION files.
Blocked pushes are attempted once and recorded as CONTEXTUAL_NON_BLOCKING when caused by external policy or unverified remote destination.
Future roadmap tasks remain unopened until explicitly selected.
Setup gaps are recorded without closing onboarding, runbook or final audit tasks.
